children: AIAI Holdings entered a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with B. Riley Principal Capital II providing up to $200 million of discretionary equity financing. Sales may occur over up to 36 months after an effective resale registration, with pricing based on VWAP and a fixed 3.0% discount, subject to a 19.99% Nasdaq exchange cap unless pricing thresholds or shareholder approval lift it, and a 4.99% ownership cap. A companion Registration Rights Agreement will register resales of shares issued under the program, enabling commencement. AIAI also issued 182,927 commitment shares as consideration and plans to use any proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
